headline: San Francisco Dog Rescued in Caltrain Tunnel Gets Second Chance
meta_description: Transit crews spotted a lost dog named Roo in a Caltrain tunnel and successfully reunited him with his owner.
summary_short: A dog named Roo was found by transit workers in a San Francisco Caltrain tunnel and safely returned to his owner.
body:
A dog named Roo has been reunited with his owner after transit crews discovered him in a Caltrain tunnel in San Francisco. The rescue offers a bright reminder of how community vigilance and quick action can turn a frightening situation into a happy ending.

Caltrain staff spotted Roo in the tunnel and worked to safely bring him out of harm's way. Rather than the dangerous journey the lost dog might have continued, he was returned to the person who had been searching for him. For Roo, the tunnel encounter became just a brief detour in an otherwise fortunate life.
quick_facts: Dog named Roo found in San Francisco Caltrain tunnel
Transit crews spotted and rescued the lost dog
Roo successfully reunited with his owner
